question: Which type of loan is supported by MUDRA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Non-farm loan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• MUDRA (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) supports loans to non-farm sector income-generating activities.
 
• It aims to promote micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector, including manufacturing, trading, and services.
 
• Loans under MUDRA are categorized into three products: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh), and Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh).
 
• MUDRA loans are provided through various financial institutions like banks, NBFCs, and MFIs.
 
• The initiative helps in providing credit to micro and small enterprises that are often excluded from the formal banking sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MUDRA Yojana:** Launched in April 2015 by the Government of India to provide financial support to non-farm small/micro enterprises.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY):** Under this scheme, MUDRA provides refinance support to banks/NBFCs/MFIs for lending to micro units.
 
• **Credit Guarantee Fund:** The Government has set up a Credit Guarantee Fund for MUDRA loans to reduce the risk for lending institutions.
 
• **Employment Generation:** MUDRA loans aim at generating self-employment opportunities and promoting entrepreneurship.
 
• **Non-Farm Sector:** Includes activities such as small manufacturing units, shopkeepers, fruits/vegetable vendors, truck operators, food-service units, repair shops, machine operators, small industries, artisans, food processors, etc.
